tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists the US cities and towns CityBotMagic covers, with business counts. Call this first if unsure whether a city is covered.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Finds local businesses in a city by keyword (name, category, service, product) and/or category. Returns contact details, hours availability and how many published prices each has.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Full record for one business: address, phone, website, hours, services, prices with sources. Pass the id from search results, or city + state + slug.

tools.name: find_prices
tools.description: Searches published prices for a product or service across a city's businesses, e.g. "haircut", "oil change", "bowling". Each price includes its source URL and the date it was read.

tools.name: price_summary
tools.description: What a common local service typically costs in a city: median, middle-half range, low and high, and every business's lowest published price with its source URL and read date. Services: oil-change, brake-service, wheel-alignment, tire-rotation, smog-check, car-detailing, car-wash, ac-tune-up, drain-c
